content: DragonRuby GTK latest in contrib repo is 7.10 (2026-06-14); 7.0 = SDL3 epoch bump, no breaking changes; tiers: Jam (free, web only, Aug 2026), Standard $48 one-time (desktop+web), Indie $96/yr (+Steam turnkey publish, C extensions, bytecode), Pro $128/yr (+mobile, highdpi, early shaders). HD mode available all tiers since 7.x. Sources: dragonruby.org, itch devlogs, contrib repo changelog.
